lines.text: 'Time's glory is to calm contending kings,
lines.meaning: It is Time's glory to calm quarrelling (contending) kings,

lines.text: To unmask falsehood and bring truth to light,
lines.meaning: to expose lies and bring the truth to light,

lines.text: To stamp the seal of time in aged things,
lines.meaning: to put the mark (seal) of age on old things,
lines.why: A seal is a stamp that proves a document is genuine. Time stamps old things with the sign that they really are old, which gives them their authority.

lines.text: To wake the morn and sentinel the night,
lines.meaning: to wake the morning and stand guard (sentinel) over the night,

lines.text: To wrong the wronger till he render right,
lines.meaning: to punish (wrong) the wrongdoer until he puts things (render) right,

lines.text: To ruinate proud buildings with thy hours,
lines.meaning: to bring proud buildings to ruin as the hours pass,

lines.text: And smear with dust their glittering golden towers;
lines.meaning: and cover their gleaming golden towers with dust.

summary: It is Time's glory to calm quarrelling kings, to expose lies and bring the truth to light, to put the mark of age on old things, to wake the morning and stand guard over the night, to punish the wrongdoer until he puts things right, to bring proud buildings to ruin as the hours pass, and to cover their gleaming golden towers with dust.
